limitations: Quote-side ranking only: base-token vault value is excluded because most newly created base mints lack reliable prices.
USD ranking includes only quote mints priced by the referenced current price feed; unpriced pools remain counted but not USD-ranked.

Candidate set is the union of the 250 largest priced virtual-book pools and the 250 largest priced unmigrated pools; every returned actual vault is live-fetched and PDA/control verified, but this is not an all-1.79M-vault balance sort.

Pool-wide book aggregates exclude creator_quote_fee because it is stored outside the compact census slice; each leading live vault fetch includes the full actual token balance and the full pool creator fee field.
Accounts changed across the stated slot interval; this is a live census, not an atomic ledger snapshot.
